---
title: Run the roadmap with two real learners
labels: needs-info, verification
---

**Context.** Every page was written and checked by maintainers only. No one at phase 1 has followed the roadmap yet.

**Plan.** Ask two people with no security background to follow phase 1 for a week. Ask them to note:
- the first place they got stuck
- any step that assumed knowledge they did not have
- any link that failed
- how long each part took against the estimate

**Done when.** The notes are turned into fixes, and the time estimates in `README.md` and `roadmap/` are adjusted if they were wrong.
